# 讚阿彌陀佛偈

**ID:** T1978
**Volume:** T47
**Category:** 淨土宗部類
**Original Category:** 諸宗部
**Byline:** 後魏 曇鸞撰
**Dynasty:** 後魏
**Date:** 476–542
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1978

## Contributors
- 曇鸞 (A001804)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juǎn* sequence of devotional verses (*jié* 偈 / gāthā) composed by [曇鸞](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%87%E9%B8%9E) **Tánluán** 曇鸞 (476–542) — one of the **Five Patriarchs** of Chinese Pure Land Buddhism and the foundational doctrinal commentator on the Pure Land tradition. The verses praise Amitābha Buddha and the splendour of Sukhāvatī, drawing principally on the *Wúliángshòu jīng* 無量壽經 (the Larger Sukhāvatīvyūha) and Vasubandhu's *Wǎngshēng lùn* 往生論 [KR6f0101](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0101).

**Abstract**

The work consists of one hundred and ninety-five seven-syllable lines, arranged into a sequence of *zàn* praising successive aspects of Amitābha and his Pure Land: the body of the Buddha (his *xiāng* 相 / *suǒ-shē* 所攝 / lakṣaṇa, his light, his lifespan, his name); the cosmology of Sukhāvatī (the jewelled trees, the lotus pools, the radiant ground, the avian choirs); the bodhisattvas and śrāvakas of the Pure Land; and the salvific operation of Amitābha's vows toward sentient beings of the Sahā-world. The verses are organised so that they can be chanted as a continuous devotional sequence, alternating with the canonical *Nā-mó ē-mí-tuó fó* 南無阿彌陀佛 invocation.

The work belongs to the same Pure Land doctrinal-devotional milieu as Tánluán's better-known **《往生論註》** *Wǎngshēng lùn zhù* [KR6f0101](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0101) (T1819) — his foundational commentary on Vasubandhu's *Pure Land treatise* — and the two works are best read together: the *Zhù* supplies the doctrinal apparatus, the *Zàn* the devotional-liturgical expression of the same doctrine. The *Zàn* is the principal early devotional Pure Land verse text in Chinese, and it set the model for the subsequent *zàn* tradition of [善導](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E5%B0%8E) Shàndǎo ([KR6p0074](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0074), [KR6p0075](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0075), [KR6p0076](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0076)), [法照](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E7%85%A7) Fǎzhào ([KR6p0078](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0078)), and the Sòng Tiāntái Pure Land authors.

The Taishō text (T47N1978) is collated against the Korean canon and *yǐ* / *jiǎ* manuscript variants. The dating bracket adopted (530–542) covers from Tánluán's mature period (after his meeting with [菩提流支](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF) **Bodhiruci** c. 529, which decisively shaped his Pure Land orientation) to his death in 542.
